title: The Tree of Life
description: Every living thing on one branching tree from a single root, four billion years deep. The five pieces of life, from the cell to the biosphere, make one endgame catalyst that never wears.

puzzle.goal: A branching tree doubles its tips at each of g levels. Write how many tips T it ends with, from one root.
puzzle.name: Lineage count
puzzle.ask: Find T for a = @{a} and g = @{g}.
puzzle.method: Each level doubles the count of lineages; from one root, g levels give 2^g: life's tree, from a single ancestor.
